name: @caotang/import-html
description: The HTML reader for the HTML import (#299): an own XHTML-to-blocks walker (no DOM, no dependency) shared by the EPUB, AO3, Kanka and Notion imports, reading a saved page or a Google Docs web-page zip into the import block list with its losses. Scripts, styles and event handlers are dropped and never run; remote images are listed, not fetched. Runs on the main thread, in a 'self' Worker and in Node.
